topic: Understand What It Means to Invest
source_evidence: When you invest, you also have the opportunity to earn more money. On the other hand, investing involves taking on some degree of risk.
answer: Investing involves a trade-off between risk and potential return: you have an opportunity to earn more money, but you also take on some risk of losing money. The amount you invest is called your principal, and you could lose it. Unlike FDIC-insured deposits, investments in securities, mutual funds, and similar investments are not federally insured—even when purchased through a bank.
